description: Main window only. core:default — basic Tauri runtime IPC for all custom commands. core:window:allow-set-focus / allow-create — window management. store:default — auth token and hotkey persistence (main window only; overlay must not read/write the store). window-state:default — save/restore main window size and position. global-shortcut:default — register/unregister rebindable hotkeys (main window only; overlay has no need to touch shortcuts).
